finding_4_volume_gate_is_the_binding_con.claim: The volume gate alone removes 85-91% of surviving candidates (27 -> 3). Every other filter downstream of it removes almost nothing. Short-event frequency is therefore almost entirely a function of volMult, not of the pattern or the trend filters.

finding_4_volume_gate_is_the_binding_con.curve_fitting_warning: volMult is the one knob that controls how fast the 8/20 forward-evidence counter fills. Lowering it to make forward evidence arrive sooner would convert the forward-evidence gate from an out-of-sample test into an in-sample selection, which is precisely the failure the gate exists to prevent. volMult should be frozen at whatever the tuned configuration already specifies, and the calendar cost of the 20-event requirement accepted as-is.

finding_5_auction_bar_contaminates_volum.severity: MEDIUM - bug, and a cross-source comparability defect
finding_5_auction_bar_contaminates_volum.claim: The 20:55Z closing-auction bar is an order of magnitude larger than a typical bar and sits inside the 20-bar volume window for the first 20 bars (100 minutes) of the FOLLOWING session, inflating the volume baseline and suppressing morning signals.
finding_5_auction_bar_contaminates_volum.cross_source_defect: The auction bar is 10.2x the median bar on Webull but only 4.5x on Robinhood, and Robinhood reports roughly 60-70% of Webull's volume overall (median WB/RH ratio 1.63 AMD, 1.43 MU). The volume gate is therefore materially STRICTER on Webull than on Robinhood for the same nominal volMult. Any Webull-vs-Robinhood signal agreement test is biased by this, and it explains the asymmetric signal counts (Webull 3 vs Robinhood 5 at volMult 1.25).
finding_5_auction_bar_contaminates_volum.recommended_action: Exclude the closing-auction bar from the volume baseline, or use a 20-bar MEDIAN instead of an SMA, and re-derive volMult per source so the gate admits a comparable fraction of bars on each feed before claiming cross-source confirmation. Treat this as a bug fix, then re-run the four-source audit - do NOT treat the resulting change in event counts as evidence for or against the strategy.
